binding_rule: the surname and the phrase must appear in the SAME sentence, and the surname must match as a whole token (R8; the USC-Arizona St. incident)
what_this_is_not: Not an availability status and not a diagnosis. No medical vocabulary is searched for at all.
reading_note: school recaps describe what happened and rarely state that a player was unavailable; a run that reads thousands of words and returns no signal is the expected result from this source, which is why the counters above are recorded.
